why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Get an access code from FX100's own site, hiring.fx100.club, by registering a wallet address. Don't use codes posted by promoters.
Open testnet.fx100.club , enter the code, then connect a wallet on Base Sepolia.
Claim mock ETH and mock USDC from the in-app faucet.
Pick a market, choose long or short, set collateral and leverage, read the preview, then confirm. You can close or set a stop loss afterwards.
Join the AladdinDAO Discord and FX100's Guild page at guild.xyz/fx100 to claim the testnet verified role.
Follow @FX100Perp on X and the Guild page for each week's testnet and X challenge.

The fees it plans for mainnet are "0.05% on BTC & ETH · 0.075% on all other markets" to open and again to close, plus keeper gas, funding and a dynamic spread.
